blackwater_hatchet.name: Blackwater Hatchet
blackwater_hatchet.unidentified_name: A hatchet with a damp handle
blackwater_hatchet.hint: The haft is always wet, even in the sun.
blackwater_hatchet.desc: Fen-witch work. It drinks a little of whatever it cuts, and it doesn't like to be put down.

emberglass_knife.name: Emberglass Knife
emberglass_knife.unidentified_name: A knife warm to the touch
emberglass_knife.hint: Warm as a hearthstone. Snow melts off it.
emberglass_knife.desc: A Collegium apprentice's test piece, a good one.
